_source: 二次审计 FAIL-5：C1-C10 中式英语陷阱缺英文黑名单词库
_usage: MODEL_B（审计角色）在 skill-2 中英对照自检 + skill-5 A26 中式英语扫描时，逐词匹配错误表达
_note: 每个 C 陷阱至少 5 组 错→对 的英文例句。模型 B 扫描时：匹配错例 → 查上下文 → 输出建议替换为对例。Gate 3 英文质量审查（E1-E5 + C1-C10）必须至少记录 3 处修改前后对照。

traps.name: 冗余范畴词（Redundant Category Nouns）
traps.zh_source: 中文习惯在动词/形容词后加范畴词（做XX的工作、进行XX的行动），英文不需要

wrong_patterns.right: decide to
wrong_patterns.note: decision 是范畴词，decide 本身就是动作

wrong_patterns.right: try to
wrong_patterns.note: attempt 范畴词，try 更地道

wrong_patterns.right: investigate
wrong_patterns.note: investigation 范畴词，investigate 是动词

wrong_patterns.right: search for
wrong_patterns.note: 同上

wrong_patterns.right: work on
wrong_patterns.note: task 范畴词，work on 更自然

wrong_patterns.right: consider
wrong_patterns.note: consideration 范畴词

wrong_patterns.right: adjust
wrong_patterns.note: adjustments 范畴词

traps.name: 中文套话直译（Literal Translation of Chinese Clichés）
traps.zh_source: 中文有大量四字成语/套话，直译英文不知所云

wrong_patterns.right: at the time
wrong_patterns.note: '众所周知'直译，历史视频应该直接说时间地点

wrong_patterns.right: contemporary records show
wrong_patterns.note: 同上，用具体来源替代套话

wrong_patterns.right: let's look at what actually happened
wrong_patterns.note: '历史证明'直译，YouTube 观众更想看故事

wrong_patterns.right: the annals record
wrong_patterns.note: 同上

wrong_patterns.right: looking at the surviving documents
wrong_patterns.note: '归根结底'直译，历史视频用史料说话

wrong_patterns.right: scholars have debated
wrong_patterns.note: '公认'直译，暗示没有争议，但历史恰恰有争议

traps.name: 主动语态缺失（Missing Active Voice）
traps.zh_source: 中文被动少、英文被动多但历史叙事需要主动，否则失去力量

wrong_patterns.wrong: It was decided by him that the capital should be moved.
wrong_patterns.right: He moved the capital.
wrong_patterns.note: 历史叙事要聚焦'谁做了什么'，不是'什么被做了'

wrong_patterns.wrong: The order was given by the emperor to execute the general.
wrong_patterns.right: The emperor ordered the general's execution.
wrong_patterns.note: 主动语态更有冲击力

wrong_patterns.wrong: Many policies were implemented by the government.
wrong_patterns.right: The court rolled out a series of new laws.
wrong_patterns.note: implemented 被动 + 抽象主语，换成主动 + 具体动词

wrong_patterns.wrong: It was believed by people that he had supernatural powers.
wrong_patterns.right: Contemporary accounts claimed he could communicate with spirits.
wrong_patterns.note: 把被动的 '被相信' 换成主动的 '当时的记载声称'

wrong_patterns.wrong: The rebellion was crushed by the army.
wrong_patterns.right: The imperial army put down the rebellion.
wrong_patterns.note: 被动语态让动作失去执行者，观众不知道是谁做的

traps.name: 模糊动词（Vague Verbs）
traps.zh_source: 中文有大量'做/搞/弄/处理'，英文对应的 do/make 太模糊

wrong_patterns.right: negotiate treaties / raise taxes / execute rivals
wrong_patterns.note: 历史叙事里 'do things' 等于没说

wrong_patterns.right: abolished the old exam system / created new military posts
wrong_patterns.note: 具体说改了什么

wrong_patterns.right: faced a grain shortage / suppressed a border uprising
wrong_patterns.note: deal with 是万能动词，历史里没有'处理问题'这种事

wrong_patterns.right: sent 50,000 troops / imposed a grain embargo
wrong_patterns.note: take measures 套话，具体说措施是什么

wrong_patterns.right: proposed moving the capital to a more defensible location
wrong_patterns.note: put forward ideas 太模糊

traps.name: 句子过长（Run-on Sentences）
traps.zh_source: 中文流水句习惯，英文历史视频每句 ≤ 25 词
traps.rule: 单句超过 25 词 → WARN；超过 35 词 → FAIL

example_fix.wrong: Wu Zetian who was originally a concubine of Emperor Taizong and then married his son Emperor Gaozong eventually became the only female emperor in Chinese history ruling from 690 to 705.
example_fix.right: Wu Zetian was originally a concubine of Emperor Taizong. She then married his son, Emperor Gaozong. In 690, she became the only woman to ever rule China as emperor.

traps.name: 抽象名词堆砌（Abstract Noun Stacking）
traps.zh_source: 中文习惯用抽象名词结尾（XX的重要性、XX的必要性），英文历史叙事需要具体

wrong_patterns.right: how troop movements decided the outcome
wrong_patterns.note: importance 是抽象名词，换成具体的'军队调动如何决定胜负'

wrong_patterns.wrong: the complexity of the political situation
wrong_patterns.right: the court was split into three competing factions
wrong_patterns.note: complexity 抽象，具体说'朝廷分成三派'

wrong_patterns.wrong: the inevitability of the dynasty's collapse
wrong_patterns.right: fiscal bankruptcy and military mutiny left the emperor with no options
wrong_patterns.note: inevitability 暗示天命，换成具体原因

wrong_patterns.right: merchants from Persia and India began arriving at Chang'an's western markets
wrong_patterns.note: development 抽象，具体说'波斯和印度商人来到长安西市'

wrong_patterns.right: Buddhist monks founded temples that became major landowners
wrong_patterns.note: influence 抽象，具体说'僧侣建庙成为大地主'

traps.name: 过度解释（Over-explanation）
traps.zh_source: 中文读者习惯背景铺垫，欧美观众喜欢直接切入
traps.rule: 前 15 秒不要出现 'In the history of China...'、'China is a country with...' 这类开场

wrong_patterns.wrong: In the long history of China, there have been many emperors...
wrong_patterns.right: In 690 CE, a woman named Wu Zetian declared herself emperor.
wrong_patterns.note: 直接切入时间+人物+事件

wrong_patterns.wrong: China is one of the oldest civilizations in the world, and its history spans thousands of years...
wrong_patterns.right: Let's go to Chang'an, 649 CE.
wrong_patterns.note: 用场景代替背景介绍

wrong_patterns.wrong: Before we talk about Wu Zetian, let's first understand the Tang dynasty...
wrong_patterns.right: To understand her rise, we need to go back twenty years.
wrong_patterns.note: 承上启下不要太生硬

traps.name: 文化负载词未解释（Unexplained Culture-specific Terms）
traps.zh_source: 中文词汇自带文化背景，欧美观众没有，需要解释（见专有名词模板）
traps.rule: 首次出现时用括号解释，见 assets/pronunciation-dict.json
example: Tang Dynasty (a golden-age Chinese ruling house, 618–907 CE)
chancellor (top civil official, equivalent to a prime minister)

traps.name: 语域错误（Wrong Register）
traps.zh_source: 中文书面语/口语分界不如英文严格，YouTube 旁白需要口语化但专业

wrong_patterns.wrong: It is imperative that we examine this matter carefully.
wrong_patterns.right: Let's look at what actually happened here.
wrong_patterns.note: imperative 书面语，YouTube 旁白用 let's

wrong_patterns.wrong: This phenomenon can be attributed to multiple factors.
wrong_patterns.right: A few things came together to make this happen.
wrong_patterns.note: phenomenon / attributed to 学术腔，换成口语

wrong_patterns.right: What happened next confirms this.
wrong_patterns.note: subsequent / corroborate / hypothesis 都是学术腔

wrong_patterns.wrong: We shall now proceed to the next topic.
wrong_patterns.right: Now, here's where it gets interesting.
wrong_patterns.note: shall 正式，换成口语过渡

traps.name: 中式衔接词（Chinese-style Transitions）
traps.zh_source: 中文衔接词（首先/其次/最后/一方面/另一方面）直译英文很生硬

wrong_patterns.wrong: On the one hand... on the other hand...
wrong_patterns.right: Here's the thing... / But there's a catch...
wrong_patterns.note: 历史叙事不用'一方面另一方面'，用故事性衔接

wrong_patterns.right: For starters... / And then... / The kicker is...
wrong_patterns.note: 数字序号衔接太机械，YouTube 用口语化过渡

wrong_patterns.right: And that's not all...
wrong_patterns.note: In addition 书面，换成口语

wrong_patterns.right: So what happened next was...
wrong_patterns.note: As a result 太干，用故事性衔接

wrong_patterns.right: Which meant...
wrong_patterns.note: Consequently 学术腔

scan_method: 1. 正则匹配 wrong_patterns[].wrong 短语。2. 句长检测（>25 词 WARN，>35 词 FAIL）。3. 被动语态占比（>15% WARN）。4. 每个匹配输出 wrong → right 替换建议。
